summary: Senior Product Designer with a focus on design systems and accessibility. Built and maintained the design system used across 40 product teams at Zalando, cutting component duplication 62%, and led accessibility audits that raised WCAG compliance to AA across checkout. Experienced in scaling consistent, trustworthy patterns across large, fast-moving product teams.
